summary: The filing is an 8-K by BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2024-5C27, a CMBS issuing entity, reporting the removal of Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer for the 640 5th Avenue Mortgage Loan and appointment of Torchlight Loan Services, LLC as successor special servicer, effective July 2, 2026. The loan constitutes ~3.1% of the asset pool. No financial terms, premium, or board recommendation are provided. This is a routine administrative servicing transition under the pooling and servicing agreement. No special-situation event is present; the filing merely updates servicer contact information and triggers no corporate action.
